notes.title: Significant Update!

tags.bug: - Fixed the time count in speedrun mode, which was duplicating the values;
- Fixed the reset of the total time in speedrun mode when you exit the game and start the mode again;
- Fixed the use of the gamepad, which was causing unexpected bugs in relation to the levels;

tags.feature: - Visual adjustments to the pause menu and start menu (the start menu now indicates the game version in the upper right corner);
- Speedrun mode now has a dedicated button in the start menu and works WITHOUT SAVING, that is, the Speedrun challenge is to complete the levels in a single "run";
- "Play" and "Continue" buttons now refer only to the standard game mode.

notes.title: First bug fix!

tags.bug: - gamepad "activated" the continue button even though it was inactive;
- using gamepad was skipping levels by two;
- continue button was not being properly activated after the game made the first save.

tags.feature: - the new cursor is now among us!

notes.title: Demo is out now!
notes.content:
Balloomia: Sky Playground demo 1.7 is out now!
What you gonna find:
- 8 levels to play;
- Default mode;
- Speedrun mode.
- A lot of fun.

Later this month it will be more updates with:
- New cursor;
- Leaderboard for speedrun.

Leave us a feedback in the community session if you face any bug.

Cheers!
